messages:
alex: Heads-up: another wave of streaming partials reported by customers in ap-south early this morning. Need a concise mitigation plan and owners.
mira: I'll pick up a short-term SDK mitigation (fast backoff + client handshake retry) and publish a patch.
jorge: I'll add server-side counters for partials with labels: region, model_variant, handshake_status. Want them in metrics within 6 hours.
tara: Infra will rotate the LB hosts serving ap-south & bump timeout to 12s for canary. I'll also run a quick socketfd leak check.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-172500 - ap-south streaming partials. Severity: P2.
alex: Please capture owner + due for each AI in this thread so oncall can act.
mira: AI-1 (mira) - SDK patch: exponential backoff (100ms -> 2s), max attempts 4, add temp client dedupe heuristic. Due: 1725030000 (8h).
jorge: AI-2 (jorge) - telemetry: emit partial_counter{reason,region,model_variant,handshake_ok}. Push to staging metrics. Due: 1725020000 (6h).
tara: AI-3 (tara) - infra: LB rotate + handshake timeout 12s on canary for ap-south, run socketfd check. Post node ids. Due: 1725018000 (3h).
alex: AI-4 (alex) - customer comms: short note to affected customers, status + ETA. Due: 1725022000 (4h).
mira: Quick note: SDK PR will include a code snippet in examples and a config flag enable_fast_retries=false for safety.
jorge: Will also tag traces with reconnect_attempts and kv_cache_status to help dedupe analysis.
tara: Found two nodes with elevated TIME_WAIT counts in ap-south; draining now. Posting log excerpt.
alex: Oncall playbook addition: if partial_rate > 4% over 15m in a region -> page infra lead + owners of active rollouts.
oncall-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: 1725036000 (tomorrow 09:00 PT).
mira: Pushed draft PR link: https://internal.redwood/pull/streaming-retry-1725 (needs review).
jorge: Adding dashboards: region breakdown + per-variant partial rate. Will attach panel links here when ready.
tara: After LB rotate partials in ap-south dropped ~60% on canary nodes. Continuing monitoring.
alex: Great. Keep this thread updated; I'll sync the AIs into the Remediation tracker and tag owners. :thumbsup:
